How PnL and ROE work on Bybit

Bybit is one of the most popular derivatives exchanges, known for a fast matching engine and deep USDT-perpetual liquidity. Your raw profit on a Bybit trade is the price move times your position size: (Exit − Entry) × Size for a long, and the reverse for a short. Price ROI is the percentage the asset moved; ROE is your return on the margin you actually posted, which Bybit's leverage multiplies.

Worked example

A 0.5-coin long opened at $60,000 and closed at $66,000 at 10× leverage:

Profit+$3,000.00
Price ROI+10.00%
ROE (10×)+100.00%

Leverage cuts both ways — the same move down would be a 100% loss of margin. Plan your exit and check your Bybit liquidation price first.

FAQ

How is ROE different from ROI on Bybit?

Price ROI is the raw % move. ROE multiplies it by your leverage — it is your return on posted margin. Fees and funding are not included.

Does Bybit show PnL automatically?

Bybit shows live PnL on open positions, but this tool lets you plan and compare scenarios before you trade.
